features: MULTIFUNCTIONAL GALAXY PROJECTOR This galaxy projector can be a ceiling projector, Bluetooth speaker, white noise sleep aid and night light. The 360 adjustable projection angle increases the projection area by 2/5, and the upgraded LED lights make the projection effect more original and realistic. The full remote control makes the Galaxy projector easier and more convenient to use.

Magical Light Effect: The Northern Lights Projector uses four colors: red, green, blue and white, and simulates various light effects through moving lights. The Boreal Galaxy light provides four lighting speeds and four brightness levels, making it easy to create a romantic, relaxing and serene atmosphere through different combinations.

SOOTHING WHITE NOISE FOR SLEEP The galaxy projector features 8 soothing white sounds: soft music, ocean waves, forest birds, music box, morning jungle, stream, campfire and pebble beach. White noise can be used as a soothing tool to immerse your mind in nature and help you relax and sleep better.
Bluetooth 5.2 Speaker: Our starlight projector incorporates a Bluetooth 5.2 speaker. Connect your HJ 05 Bluetooth device and enjoy exceptional sound quality and 12-level volume control.

Programmable Projector: This night light projector can be programmed to turn off for 1-2 hours. (It turns off after 4 hours of operation without a timer.) This extends the length of your projector. In addition, thanks to its powerful motors and lights, the ENOKIK star projector is quiet and durable.
